common.somethingWentWrong: Something went wrong — try again shortly.
common.languageChangeFailed: Couldn't change the language — try again.

bell.title: Notifications
bell.tooltipWithNotices: School notices and your reported issues
bell.emptyWithNotices: Nothing here yet — school notices, and the progress of anything you report, show up right here.
bell.emptyIssuesOnly: Nothing here yet — when you report a problem, its progress shows up right here until it's resolved.

student.title: My lessons
student.subtitle: Everything your teacher has assigned to you.
student.downloadsNotReady: Downloads aren't available yet — ask your teacher to finish setup.
student.empty: Nothing assigned yet. Check back after your teacher shares a lesson.

item.partWontLoad: Part {n} couldn't load — refresh the page
item.quizUnavailable: Quiz unavailable — use Submit answer instead.

player.lessonComplete: That was the last part — the whole lesson is complete!
player.onePartADay: One part a day keeps it easy. Come back tomorrow, or keep going now.
player.alreadyCompleted: You've already completed this lesson — great revising!
player.nextUpPart: Parts count in order — next up for you is Part {n}.
player.partLoadFailed: Part {n} couldn't load just now — close this and refresh the page to try again.
player.multiPartHint: Part {n} of {total} (~15 min). Finish a part to check it off — the last part completes the lesson.
player.singlePartHint: Watch to the end to mark this lesson complete.

forgot.subtitle: Reset your password
forgot.sent: If an account exists for that email, a reset link is on its way. Check your inbox (and spam folder).
forgot.studentHint: That looks like a student ID. Student accounts don't have an email — ask your teacher or parent to reset your password from their dashboard.

updatePassword.subtitle: Choose a new password
updatePassword.expired: This link has expired or you're not signed in.
updatePassword.updated: Password updated — taking you to your dashboard…
updatePassword.tooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.subtitle: Free for teachers & students
signup.confirmEmail: Check your email to confirm your account, then sign in.

schoolSignup.title: Set up your school
schoolSignup.subtitle: Create your school on SketchCast, then invite your teachers.
schoolSignup.confirmEmail: Check your email to confirm your account — then you'll name your school.
schoolSignup.nextStepHint: You'll name your school on the next step.

finish.title: Name your school
finish.signedInAs: Signed in as {email}. This creates your school and makes you its admin — you can invite teachers right after.

invite.used: This invitation has already been used.
invite.title: You're invited

reason.email: That invitation is for a different email address — sign out and use that email.
reason.apply: Something went wrong accepting the invitation. Please try again.
reason.server: Invites aren't configured on the server.
reason.role: A student account can't accept a parent invitation — sign out and use the parent's own account.

invite.wrongAccount: You're signed in as {signedIn}, but this invite is for {invited}. Sign out and use that email.
invite.confirmEmail: Check your email to confirm your account — the confirmation link will finish accepting the invite automatically.

onboarding.title: Welcome — let's set you up
onboarding.subtitle: A couple of quick questions so SketchCast fits how you'll use it. You can change these later.
onboarding.childrenCount: How many children will you support?
onboarding.heardFrom: How did you hear about us?
onboarding.completeRequired: Please complete the required fields marked with *.

reportIssue.label: Report a problem
reportIssue.summaryPlaceholder: e.g. Deck download fails on Unit 3
reportIssue.detailsPlaceholder: What did you expect, what happened instead?
reportIssue.sendFailedNetwork: Could not send — check your connection and try again.
reportIssue.sendFailed: Could not send — please try again.
reportIssue.attachedOneFailed: Sent, but 1 screenshot couldn't be attached.
reportIssue.attachedSomeFailed: Sent, but {n} screenshots couldn't be attached.

betaBanner.body: Your free trial includes {trial}. Classes, assigning, reviewing, and analytics are all unlimited. Questions?
betaBanner.trial: 1 book and the full kit — video lesson, plan, activities, worksheet, test paper and case study — for one part of one chapter

library.title: Your library
library.body: Every textbook you upload lives here. Open one to turn its chapters into lessons.

generate.title: Turn a chapter into a lesson
generate.body: Pick a chapter and generate a full narrated video lesson from it — automatically.

output.title: Watch & download
output.body: Play the finished lesson, or download the editable slide deck and worksheets.

assign.title: Assign to a class
assign.body: Share a chapter's lesson, worksheet and quiz with your students in one click.

assistant.title: AI Teaching Assistant
assistant.body: A book-grounded helper — ask it anything from your books, and it can check maths too.

classes.title: Your classes
classes.body: Create classes and add students to start tracking their progress.

assignments.title: Your work
assignments.body: Everything your teacher assigns you shows up right here.

open.title: Watch a lesson
open.body: Open a lesson to watch the video or read through the slides.

assistant.title: Ask the Assistant
assistant.body: Stuck on something? Ask the AI assistant — it answers from your own books.

progress.title: Your progress
progress.body: See what you've finished and what's still to do.

assignments.title: Your child's work
assignments.body: See what each child has been assigned and how they're getting on.

recap.title: Progress & recap
recap.body: Track completion and scores at a glance — no guesswork.

practice.title: Make extra practice
practice.body: Create practice papers for your child anytime under Test Papers.

school.title: Manage your school
school.body: Open your school area to add teachers, students and classes.

branding.title: School branding
branding.body: Add your school's logo and colours to every lesson and document.

health.title: Book health
health.body: A quick quality score shows which textbooks are ready to teach from.

classes.title: Classes & students
classes.body: Create classes and enrol students to track their progress.

welcome.title: Welcome to SketchCast
welcome.body: Here's a quick 30-second look at what you can do as a coordinator.

oversight.title: What you oversee
oversight.body: The classes and teachers in your remit will appear in this area.

help.title: Need a hand?
help.body: Replay this tour anytime with this button — and you can always report a problem.

diary.title: Diary
diary.teacherIntro: The daily communication book — notes home, replies, parent signatures, and what happened in class.
diary.parentIntro: The daily communication book — one page per day, per child. Sign notes so the teacher knows you've seen them.
diary.studentIntro: Notes from your teachers, one day at a time — reply to keep them posted.
diary.noClasses: Create a class on your Library first — the diary is written per class.
diary.noChildrenLinked: No children linked yet — add your child under My Children first.
diary.noNotesWriteFirst: No notes for this day yet — write the first one above.

note.translateAria: Translate this note — sends the text to our AI translation provider
note.translateTitle: Machine translation — the text of this note is sent to our AI provider to translate it
note.deleteNoteConfirm: Delete this note and its replies? The parents' signatures on it go too.
note.signedTitle: Parents who have signed this note, out of the enrolled students with a linked parent account
note.translationPartial: Translation incomplete — {missing} of {total} messages still show the original.
note.signFailed: Could not sign — please try again.

compose.title: Write in the diary
compose.placeholder: Write a note home — homework, reminders, how the day went…
compose.parentsOnlyHint: — hidden from students; parents, teachers and school leadership still see it

parentCompose.placeholder: A private note for {name}'s teachers — e.g. absence, medication, something from home…
parentCompose.letChildSeeHint: Off by default — you, {name}'s teachers and school leadership can read it, but {name} cannot.

schoolDiary.title: School diary
schoolDiary.intro: Read-only oversight of the teacher↔home communication book. Writing stays with the participants — this view is recorded in the access audit.
schoolDiary.noClassesInScope: No classes in your scope yet.

ack.failed: Could not confirm — please try again.

composer.title: Publish a notice
composer.subtitle: One announcement to the whole school or to the staff room — with a link, a deadline, or both.
composer.consequenceStaff: Staff will be asked to confirm they have read it.
composer.consequenceImportant: Parents will be asked to acknowledge. It also appears in each child's diary day.
composer.consequenceNormal: It appears on dashboards and in each child's diary day. Nobody is asked to acknowledge.
composer.bodyPlaceholder: What people need to know. Keep it short — the details can live behind the link.
composer.actionLabelPlaceholder: What to call the deadline — Register by, Pay by, Reply by
composer.clocksHint: The countdown shows the deadline first, then switches to the event date once the deadline passes. A notice can have just one of the two.
composer.markImportantStaffHint: — stands out in the staff list
composer.featureHint: — the pin lets go on its own; three notices show at most.

revoke.confirm: Withdraw “{title}”? It leaves dashboards, class diaries and any subscribed calendar. The record is kept for your audit trail.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.intro: Meetings, exams, holidays and assignment due dates — everyone sees their own slice.
calendar.manageSubtitle: Events you created or can edit in {month}.
calendar.withdrawnNote: Withdrawn in {month} — kept for your record, and visible to leadership only. Nobody else sees these, on any surface.
calendar.upcomingSubtitle: The next 30 days in your slice.

editor.titleAndStartRequired: A title and a start time are required.
editor.pickAClass: Pick a class for a class event.
editor.cannotSave: You can't save this event (check the audience/class).

subscribe.title: Subscribe from your calendar app
subscribe.pasteHint: Paste this personal address — it shows exactly what you can see here, and stays up to date.

library.title: Your library
library.subtitle: Upload a textbook, then generate a narrated lesson from it.
library.noBookTools: Your account is set up for teaching without book tools (PE, music, arts and similar subjects) — your timetable and classes are below. If that's wrong, ask your school to contact SketchCast support.

empty.withStepper: Your library is empty — start with step 1 above.
empty.title: Your library is empty — here's the whole journey:
empty.step2: Generate a narrated lesson for a chapter
empty.step3: Assign it to your class & watch progress
empty.note: Chapters are detected automatically — scanned books included.

book.scannedWarning: This file has no text layer, so chapters are detected by image recognition — the list below, and anything generated from it, may be unreliable.
book.scannedAdvice: For best results upload a text-based (digitally exported) PDF, and use “Report an issue” on anything that comes out wrong.

kit.generateFullKitHint: The video lesson plus its plan, activities, worksheet, test paper and case study — documents free, one credit per rendered lesson part
kit.generateFreeHint: Free — these reuse the lesson's analysis
kit.trialLockedHint: Your free trial covers the full kit (all six content types) for one part of one chapter
kit.trialPickHint: This chapter is split into parts — your trial covers the full kit (all six content types) for one part of your choice
kit.trialPinnedHint: Your trial kit lives on this part — retries and every content type for it stay open

upload.trialTeacher: The free trial is limited to 1 book — explore all its chapters and generate the full kit for one part of one chapter.
upload.trialParent: The free trial is limited to 1 book — generate test papers from its chapters.
upload.bigBook: — big book; keep this tab open while it uploads
upload.choosePdf: Choose a PDF, or scan pages, to enable upload
upload.limits: PDF only · one file at a time · up to 200 MB.
upload.retryAdvice: {error} Please check your internet connection and try again — large textbooks need a stable connection for a few minutes.

scan.title: Scan pages
scan.intro: Photograph the pages and we'll turn them into one PDF.
scan.tips: Best results: one chapter at a time, page flat, good light, fills the frame.
scan.inAppBrowser: Cameras often fail inside the Gmail/WhatsApp browser — open sketchcast.app in Chrome or Safari, or use Choose photos.
scan.cameraHint: Nothing came back from the camera? Use Choose photos to pick from your gallery instead.
scan.notPhotos: Those files weren't photos — pick images of the pages.
scan.budgetStop: Stopped at {size} — a scan has to stay under 200 MB. Create this PDF and upload it, then scan the next chapter separately.
scan.tooBig: That PDF is {size} — over the 200 MB limit. Remove some pages, or scan this book one chapter at a time.
scan.heicOne: 1 photo couldn't be read — if your camera saves HEIC (“high efficiency”) photos, switch the camera to “Most compatible”/JPEG, or use Choose photos.
scan.heicMany: {n} photos couldn't be read — if your camera saves HEIC (“high efficiency”) photos, switch the camera to “Most compatible”/JPEG, or use Choose photos.
scan.uncroppedOne: 1 page wasn't cropped automatically — tap a page to set its edges by hand.
scan.uncroppedMany: {n} pages weren't cropped automatically — tap a page to set its edges by hand.
scan.editIntro: Drag the four corners to the corners of the page.

revision.openHint: Generate worksheets and test papers for revision across a group of chapters
revision.intro: For term, mid-term and exam revision: pick a group of chapters and generate worksheets and/or test papers.
revision.introFree: Free, from the lessons you've already generated.
revision.combineAll: One paper across the selected chapters
revision.needTwo: Pick at least two chapters to combine — or switch to one per chapter.
revision.queuedOne: Queued 1 revision paper — see “Revision papers” below.
revision.queuedMany: Queued {n} revision papers — see “Revision papers” below.

examTool.openHint: Build a cumulative exam (paper + answer key) over the chapters and parts you've taught
examTool.intro: A cumulative exam over everything you've taught — one exam paper plus a separate answer key. Tick the chapters and parts to test (untick to skip), set the difficulty and how many questions of each type.
examTool.queued: Exam queued — the paper and its answer key appear under “Exams” below.

classes.heading: Classes & students
classes.duplicate: You already have a class named “{name}”.
classes.betaFull: Beta is limited to 2 students — you've added both. You can assign work to them and review their responses freely.
classes.credsCreated: Logins created — give these to parents

progress.empty: No students enrolled, or nothing assigned yet.

assignModal.heading: Assign to a class
assignModal.itemsOne: 1 item — the class's students will see this in their assignments.
assignModal.itemsMany: {n} items — the class's students will see this in their assignments.
assignModal.duplicate: You already have a class named “{name}”.

deleteLesson.confirm: Remove this lesson? This cancels it if it's still running.

branding.heading: School branding
branding.notSet: optional · use your school's format & theme
branding.intro: Upload your school's Word and PowerPoint templates. New documents open from the .docx template; decks and the video slides adopt the .pptx theme, colours and logo.

analytics.title: School analytics
analytics.subtitle: Signals that prompt support — not a ranking.

worklist.title: Students needing support
worklist.hint: Flagged by low/declining completion, falling scores, or inactivity — the worklist to act on first.
worklist.empty: No students flagged in this scope.

byGrade.note: Names live in the grade/subject coordinator's worklist, so support stays close to the student. As principal you can also open the School briefing (bottom-right) for names and reasons — every briefing is recorded in the access audit.

teachers.title: Teachers
teachers.intro: Activity and how each teacher's students are doing — to spot who could use support. Not a ranking.
teachers.introBaseline: Activity and how each teacher's students are doing — to spot who could use support, against the cohort baseline ({pct}% completion). Not a ranking.
teachers.empty: No teachers in this scope yet.
teachers.footnote: Teachers can see their own school-visible metrics on their Analytics page — the school sees no more about a teacher than the teacher can see about themselves.

access.title: Who can see what
access.subtitle: Exactly how data is scoped by role. Enforced in the database (row-level security), not just hidden in the UI.

student.sees: Only their own lessons, progress, and submissions.

teacher.sees: Only their own classes, students, content, grading, and submissions.

coordinator.sees: A teacher granted oversight of specific grade(s) — and subject(s), if set: the students, teachers, and content in that slice. Nothing outside it. They keep their own teacher dashboard.

principal.sees: Whole-school totals and trends, plus named at-risk students on request via the school briefing (each briefing is recorded in the access audit). The day-to-day named worklist stays with the grade/subject coordinator. Admin also manages scopes, reads the access-audit log, and can teach classes of their own.

reach.title: Coordinators & their reach
reach.hint: What each coordinator's scope resolves to right now. Manage these on the Admin screen.
reach.empty: No coordinators yet — everyone is a teacher (own classes only) or admin (whole school).

mine.title: Your access
mine.hint: Exactly your slice — and nothing beyond it.
mine.noScope: You have no scope assigned yet, so you can't see any student data. Ask your admin to assign you a grade.
mine.covers: That covers {classes} classes, {students} students, and {teachers} teachers. Anything in other grades is invisible to you.

admin.title: School admin
admin.subtitle: Roles & oversight scopes — who can see which slice of the school, and a log of who looked.

notices.title: Published notices
notices.hint: Everything the school has announced, and how far it has been read. Withdrawing removes a notice from dashboards, class diaries and subscribed calendars — the record stays here.
notices.ackNoParents: {n} acknowledged — no linked parents on the roster yet
notices.unverifiedOne: 1 linked parent does not match the email on the student record — on the record for {names}. Nothing is blocked; they still receive every notice. Worth confirming with the family when you next speak.
notices.unverifiedMany: {n} linked parents do not match the email on the student record — on the records for {names}. Nothing is blocked; they still receive every notice. Worth confirming with the family when you next speak.

members.title: Members
members.hint: Teachers & coordinators in your school. Resetting hands you a temporary password to pass on — it's shown once, and they must choose a new one at their next sign-in.

students.title: Students
students.hint: Every student account in your school. Deleting is permanent — the sign-in, class enrollments and submitted work are all removed.

audit.title: Access audit
audit.hint: Every leadership view of student data is logged here for the data-protection trail.

coordinators.title: Coordinators & scopes
coordinators.intro: Coordinator access is an add-on for a teacher: they keep their own classes and dashboard, and additionally see only the grades (and optional subjects) you assign — nothing outside that slice.
coordinators.noGrades: No class grades exist yet — add a grade to a class first, then you can scope a coordinator to it.
coordinators.noScope: No scope yet — add a grade below (otherwise they see nothing).
coordinators.allGranted: Every teacher already has coordinator access.
coordinators.addGradeFirst: Add a grade to a class first.

briefing.subtitle: Answers from your live school data
briefing.unavailable: The briefing isn't available right now.
briefing.unreachable: Couldn't reach the briefing. Try again in a moment.
briefing.failed: The briefing is unavailable right now.
briefing.placeholder: Ask about completion, at-risk students, grading…
briefing.footnote: Uses only the analytics you can already see here. Every briefing is recorded in the access audit.

assistant.title: AI Teaching Assistant
assistant.subtitle: Answers from your books
assistant.unavailable: The assistant isn't available right now.
assistant.unreachable: Couldn't reach the assistant. Try again in a moment.
assistant.failed: The assistant is unavailable right now.
assistant.footnote: I help you learn from your books — hints and method, never the graded answers.

timetable.title: Timetable
timetable.intro: Build each class's week — clashes where a teacher is in two rooms at once light up instantly.
timetable.noClasses: No classes yet — the timetable appears once your school's classes are set up. SketchCast provisions staff and classes with you during onboarding; contact support to get started.

absence.title: Absences & cover
absence.hint: Everyone is assumed present until marked absent. Cover is computed when you mark — re-mark after big grid changes.
absence.noLessons: No lessons to cover that day.

generate.title: Auto-generate the timetable
generate.intro: Confirm who teaches what — the class teacher takes Period 1 every day, core subjects ({core}) run once every day, the other subjects fill the rest of the week, and no teacher is ever in two rooms at once.
generate.noTeacher: no teacher — will be reported as a gap
generate.gapsHint: Assign more teachers to those subjects and run “Fill gaps”.
generate.noGaps: No gaps — the week is fully staffed.

editor.clashesOne: 1 clash: a teacher is timetabled in two classes at once — clashing cells are outlined.
editor.clashesMany: {n} clashes: a teacher is timetabled in two classes at once — clashing cells are outlined.
editor.dragTip: Tip: drag a lesson onto another cell to move it (onto a filled cell to swap). 🔒 locked cells are never touched by the auto-generator, day tools, or drags.
editor.confirmClear: {label} for {class}? {n} lesson(s) will be removed (locked cells stay). You can undo this.
editor.subject: Subject
editor.lock: Lock (auto-generate and day tools never touch it)
editor.nonTeachingOption: Non-teaching (assembly, free period — no clash or load counting)
editor.cannotEdit: You can't edit this class's timetable.
editor.capWarning: {teacher} already has {count} lessons on {day} (limit {max}). You can still save — the limit is a guideline for humans, a rule for the generator.

roster.title: Teachers ({n})
roster.blockedFull: Fully booked every day — cannot be assigned as a substitute
roster.blockedSpare: Has spare capacity on at least one day — can take cover then
roster.allCovered: Every grade & section has a class teacher.
roster.uncovered: Without a serving class teacher: {classes} — assign one below.
roster.reassignNote: Reassigning moves the class — its students and join code — to the new class teacher. Timetable lessons keep their own subject teachers.
roster.reassignFailed: Could not reassign the class teacher.

settings.title: Timetable settings (hours, breaks, periods)
settings.computedNote: All times are computed: Period 1 starts when school starts, each period runs {min} minutes, and every break pushes the rest of the day later. School ends when the last period does.
settings.weekNote: Week: {days}. Removing periods or days never deletes lessons — anything stranded outside the new shape is reported so you can tidy up.
settings.invalidStart: School start time isn't a valid hh:mm time.
settings.savedOrphaned: Saved. ⚠ {n} existing lesson(s) now sit outside the new shape (a removed day or period) — grow the shape back or clear them.
settings.saved: Saved — the timetable now shows the new times.
settings.unsaved: Unsaved changes — the timetable updates after you save

myTimetable.title: My timetable
myTimetable.teacherIntro: The lessons you teach this week.
myTimetable.empty: No lessons on the timetable yet — it appears here as soon as the school publishes it.

myAnalytics.title: Analytics
myAnalytics.subtitle: How your classes are progressing through what you've assigned.

schoolView.title: What your school sees about your teaching
schoolView.note: Leadership sees these to spot where to help — never as a ranking.

myAnalytics.mostRevisedHint: Topics students re-open most — often the trickiest ones.
myAnalytics.toGradeHint: Submitted worksheets & exams awaiting a mark.

children.title: My children
children.subtitle: What each child is working on — schoolwork read-only, plus the test papers you assign.
children.empty: No children linked yet. Add your child below — or if their school invited you, open the link from that email.
children.unverified: unverified link · confirm with the school
children.noTestPapers: No test papers assigned yet — create one under Test Papers.

add.title: Add a child
add.hint: Creates their sign-in (child ID + a temporary password you hand to them).
add.signInNote: They sign in at app.sketchcast.app with the ID (no email needed) and set their own password.
